crossDictionary.exactParagraph: The [cross-dictionary analysis](jmdict-iteration-20261120/cross-dictionary-tradeoff.md) finds that JMnedict adopts only 55.59% of retained bytes and finishes parsing earlier without shortening its busy sink. Its sampled memory increase exceeds its entire owned-content volume, so the content queue alone cannot explain the difference. A useful next experiment would budget complete queued outputs while keeping input partitioning constant: the current lead parameter also changes group count. No such alternative is validated here, and a size threshold selected merely to separate these two fixtures is not included.
